baseline_acceptance: pending 6255; native source and schedule unchanged
observed_source_defects: Float is invented as 80% of market cap divided by price, without reported float, issuer/currency/time consistency or corporate-action continuity.

Cumulative daily short-sale volume is labeled a days-to-cover proxy, enters investment tiers and becomes unqualified days_to_cover in the summary. Daily short-sale flows do not establish outstanding short interest.
FINRA same-date duplicates, invalid row dates, impossible short/total counts and overwritten symbol rows are not identified. Facility coverage and exempt volumes are not retained in calculations.

EOD data is cut to ninety source-order rows before sorting. Missing volume becomes zero and boolean prices become numbers. Repeated/future dates and mismatched issuer/currency data can create a high squeeze score.
Thirty source rows are labeled thirty-day windows without session validation; unobserved longer returns become zero. An unavailable older short-volume window becomes unchanged zero.
Claimed real-revenue and borrowing-cost filters are not acquired or enforced; publication lacks complete original provider populations, request outcomes and independent forward validation.
